subject: general
question: The term "Bharat-VISTAAR" was in the limelight during the presentation of the Union Budget 2026-27. It is related to which of the following?

options.text: A new military doctrine behind the defence budget boost
A scholarship scheme for students studying abroad
A multilingual AI-based platform for farmers
A new dedicated freight corridor for industrial hubs

solution:
The correct answer is __**A multilingual AI-based platform for farmers.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **During the presentation of the Union Budget 2026-27, the Finance Minister announced "Bharat-VISTAAR" as a key innovation for the agricultural sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat-VISTAAR** is a **multilingual AI-based platform** designed to assist farmers.
 
• It integrates **AgriStack** and **ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research)** systems.
 
• The primary goal of this platform is to provide **customised advisory services** to farmers.
 
• This initiative falls under the "Third Kartavya" of the Budget, which focuses on inclusive development and targeted initiatives for farmers and vulnerable groups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Other Initiatives for Farmers (Budget 2026-27)__

 
 
• **SME Growth Fund:** ₹10,000 crore proposed to nurture future enterprises, which indirectly aids the agri-business sector.
 
• **Veterinary Education:** Expanded to add over 20,000 professionals, supporting livestock farmers.
